env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

env REC_STACKBUF=32
env TIER_STACKBUF=4096
logos test -count=1 -O=3 .
stdout '^ok'
go test -count=1 -O=3 .
stdout '^ok'

env TIER_STACKBUF=256
logos test -count=1 -O=2 .
stdout '^ok'
go test -count=1 -O=2 .
stdout '^ok'
env REC_STACKBUF=
env TIER_STACKBUF=
env REC_STACKBUF=32
env TIER_STACKBUF=32
logos test -count=1 -O=1 .
stdout '^ok'
logos test -count=1 -O=0 .
stdout '^ok'
go test -count=1 -O=0 .
stdout '^ok'

module example.com/recstackbuf

-- logos.toml --
[build]
arena = false

-- recstackbuf_test.go --
package recstackbuf

import (
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"testing"
)

func helper(n int) byte {
	b := make([]byte, n)
	b[0] = 7
	return b[n-1]
}

//go:noinline
func recMake(n int, depth int) byte {
	b := make([]byte, n)
	b[0] = 7
	if depth > 0 {
		return b[n-1] + recMake(n, depth-1)
	}
	return b[n-1]
}

//go:noinline
func tierProbe(n int) byte {
	b := make([]byte, n)
	b[0] = 9
	return b[n-1]
}

//go:noinline
func recProbe(n int, depth int) byte {
	if depth > 0 {
		return recProbe(n, depth-1) + helper(n)
	}
	return helper(n)
}

func allocs(n int, depth int) float64 {
	return testing.AllocsPerRun(10, func() { _ = recProbe(n, depth) })
}

func recMakeAllocs(n int, depth int) float64 {
	return testing.AllocsPerRun(10, func() { _ = recMake(n, depth) })
}

func tierAllocs(n int) float64 {
	return testing.AllocsPerRun(10, func() { _ = tierProbe(n) })
}

func TestRecursiveFrame(t *testing.T) {
	recWant, err := strconv.Atoi(os.Getenv("REC_STACKBUF"))
	if err != nil || recWant < 2 {
		t.Fatalf("REC_STACKBUF=%q: want a byte count of at least 2", os.Getenv("REC_STACKBUF"))
	}
	tierWant, err := strconv.Atoi(os.Getenv("TIER_STACKBUF"))
	if err != nil || tierWant < 2 {
		t.Fatalf("TIER_STACKBUF=%q: want a byte count of at least 2", os.Getenv("TIER_STACKBUF"))
	}
	for _, c := range []struct {
		n     int
		stack bool
	}{
		{recWant / 2, true},
		{recWant, true},
		{recWant + 1, false},
		{2*recWant + 1, false},
	} {
		if got := allocs(c.n, 2); (got == 0) != c.stack {
			t.Errorf("recursive make of %d bytes took %v allocations, want recursive buffer %d to decide: stack=%v", c.n, got, recWant, c.stack)
		}
		if got := recMakeAllocs(c.n, 2); (got == 0) != c.stack {
			t.Errorf("cycle-function make of %d bytes took %v allocations, want cycle buffer %d to decide: stack=%v", c.n, got, recWant, c.stack)
		}
	}
	for _, c := range []struct {
		n     int
		stack bool
	}{
		{tierWant / 2, true},
		{tierWant, true},
		{tierWant + 1, false},
		{2*tierWant + 1, false},
	} {
		if got := tierAllocs(c.n); (got == 0) != c.stack {
			t.Errorf("non-recursive make of %d bytes took %v allocations, want tier buffer %d to decide: stack=%v", c.n, got, tierWant, c.stack)
		}
	}
}
